title.narrative: Agricultural Development: Fostering Climate-Resilient Upland Farming Systems in the Northeast (FOCUS) 2.0

description.narrative: PROSPER will target 100,000 households with an estimated population of 500,000 people. 48,900 households, originally part of FOCUS, will continue benefiting from PROSPER to consolidate earlier efforts. The project will support three main target groups with differentiated targeting strategies and packages of interventions: (i) small and marginal farmers with less than 1.0 ha of land; (ii) landless farmers; and (iii) women and youth. Youth unemployment in rural Mizoram lies at 15.8%, with a strong gender gap, as 26.7% of young women are unemployed against 11.1% of young men. Thus, PROSPER will target 30% youth, particularly through entrepreneurship/ incubation activities. A gender strategy will be developed to leverage the potential of young women. The selection of value chains will be guided by opportunities for integrating these target groups, either as actors in the value chains or as service providers to the value chains, ensuring inclusive and equitable participation.
